en.title: FAR 52.225-9(b)(3)(i) and 52.225-11(b)(4)(i): headings (A) and (B) overlap when a material is a critical item or contains critical components, but not both
en.summary: In both clauses, heading (A) covers “domestic construction material that is not a critical item or does not contain critical components”, and heading (B) covers material that “is a critical item or contains critical components”. When exactly one of the two conditions holds, both headings apply. The corresponding heading in FAR 25.204(b)(1) uses “and”: material that “is not a critical item and does not contain critical components”. The list of critical items at 25.105(a)(1)-(2) is reserved.
en.impact: No affected award has been established while the list of critical items is reserved.
en.correction: Use “and” in heading (A) of both clauses, as in 25.204(b)(1).

quotes.text: (A) For domestic construction material that is not a critical item or does not contain critical components.
(B) For domestic construction material that is a critical item or contains critical components.
The procedures in paragraph (b)(4)(i)(A)(2) of this clause will no longer apply as of January 1, 2030.
For construction material that is not a critical item and does not contain critical components.
